feedback.text: Shot 1, Good high release above the shoulder. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~109°). Score 67.
Shot 2, David, Lock the rim with your eyes, then lift. Eyes on the rim before you lift. Score 77.
Shot 3, Square your feet a touch more to the rim (83° off). Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~93°). Score 62.
Shot 4, Toe angles matched well — stable base. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~94°). Score 60.
Shot 5, Eyes on the rim before you lift. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~103°). Score 69.
Shot 6, Snap the wrist so fingers point down on the finish. Freeze the finish for 2 counts; don’t drop early. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~95°). Score 62.
Shot 7, David, Pick the target earlier — eyes to the rim. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~103°). Score 66.
Shot 8, Raise the release point before the snap. Get the forearm more vertical at release (48° off). Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~95°). Score 60.
Shot 9, Good high release above the shoulder. Square your feet a touch more to the rim (88° off). Score 69.
Shot 10, Center your body line with the rim before you lift. Add a little upward pop as you snap. Score 75.
